evidence.section: Effect SPS parameters on densification and structure
evidence.quote: The grain growth is fast for the samples densiﬁed at sintering temperatures of 1100 /C176C leading to an average grain size of 29.8 lm.

evidence.section: Effect SPS parameters on densification and structure
evidence.quote: A decrease in sintering temperature to 800 /C176C signiﬁcantly reduces grain growth leading to an average grain size of 6.4 lm.
Improved grain boundary bonding in the samples sintered at the highest sintering temperature led to a suppression of intergranular fracture
it is suggested that the greater proportion of residual stress left in samples sintered under the slowest heating rates contributed to the increased coercivity.
